_howto: Each tool appears in its group on /calculators/. Established tools link to their own page. Models open a model card at /calculators/model?id=<id>. status: live | in-development | planned. A model is calculated in the browser when it has an 'engine' (see examples/logistic-model-example.json), or embedded when it has an 'embedUrl' (e.g. a shinyapps.io app). Leave a field empty to hide it.

groups.name: Established calculators
groups.intro: Published formulas and severity scales used in craniofacial practice, each with its source.

groups.name: Our outcome models
groups.intro: Prediction models developed from institutional data. Each has a model card describing its development cohort, validation, and limitations.

groups.name: ACS NSQIP models
groups.intro: Risk models built from American College of Surgeons National Surgical Quality Improvement Program data, covering perioperative outcomes across many hospitals.
groups.empty: The first NSQIP-based calculators are in preparation.
groups.disclaimer: The American College of Surgeons National Surgical Quality Improvement Program and the hospitals participating in the ACS NSQIP are the source of the data used herein; they have not verified and are not responsible for the statistical validity of the data analysis or the conclusions derived by the authors.

tools.name: Cranial vault asymmetry index
tools.summary: Quantifies plagiocephaly from two cranial diagonals and grades it on the Children's Healthcare of Atlanta scale.

tools.name: Cephalic index
tools.summary: Head width as a percentage of length, for brachycephaly and scaphocephaly.

tools.name: Estimated blood volume and allowable blood loss
tools.summary: Weight- and age-based blood volume with maximum allowable blood loss by the Gross formula, for cranial vault and other pediatric cases.

tools.name: CranioSTRIP
tools.summary: Machine learning model estimating perioperative transfusion risk in craniosynostosis surgery.

tools.name: Cleft palate speech outcomes
tools.summary: Machine learning model estimating speech outcomes after cleft palate repair.
